items.title: Cybercrime Laws and Data Protection Policies in Pakistan

source_refs.note: Unnumbered topic Cybercrime Laws and Data Protection Policies in Pakistan under 9.5 as printed (PDF 136, printed 132).

blocks.text: Pakistan has laws to prevent cybercrime and protect digital information. The Prevention of Electronic Crimes Act (PECA) 2016 is the main law in Pakistan that deals with cybercrime. It aims to protect individuals, organizations, and the state from illegal activities carried out using computers, mobile devices, and the internet. These laws cover hacking, identity theft, online fraud, and unauthorized access to data. Organizations are required to follow data protection policies to secure sensitive information. Legal penalties exist for violating cybercrime and data privacy laws. Following these regulations helps maintain security and trust in digital systems within the country.
